# 2 000 morning trips between random junctions, as rows.
import random

rng = random.Random(1)
corners = list(zip(nodes["x_coord"], nodes["y_coord"], strict=True))
trips = []
for k in range(2000):
    (olon, olat), (dlon, dlat) = rng.sample(corners, 2)
    trips.append(ms.Trip(f"p{k}", 0, olon, olat, dlon, dlat, 7 * 3600 + rng.randrange(3600), "default"))
trips[0]
